candidate.early_exit_role: separate secondary policy charged a second taker fee and independently validated; excluded from the primary candidate
candidate.maker_role: excluded because public depth and trade direction do not identify the bot's queue position or fill
candidate.primary_objective: calibrated after-cost settlement value, not direction accuracy alone

required_sources: official Gamma market identity and resolution contract
exact Chainlink TWAP60 E18 RTDS observations
Polymarket CLOB L2 public market channel

economic_simulation.entry: first executable ask after the recorded 250 ms taker delay, capped by displayed depth
economic_simulation.fee: exact per-market quantity * rate * price * (1-price), conservatively rounded to five decimals
economic_simulation.payout: official resolved outcome token pays one USDC and the losing token pays zero
economic_simulation.slippage: observed book traversal only; no midpoint fills

binance_receipt_time: spot and perpetual log returns at 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000 ms
spot and perpetual aggressor signed notional imbalance
receipt rate and source-to-receipt delay state
polymarket_book: executable up and down bid, ask, spread and depth
book age, connection segment and recent quote response
market-implied up probability as the mandatory baseline offset
settlement_state: exact current TWAP60 minus exact opening TWAP60
trailing TWAP60 change variance and path efficiency

hypotheses.primary: exact TWAP60 settlement state plus fast CEX innovations contains incremental calibrated settlement value beyond the executable Polymarket book prior
hypotheses.secondary: the incremental value is concentrated in stale-book response states and late-window TWAP states rather than continuously available
hypotheses.null: the Polymarket book already incorporates the public inputs quickly enough that no after-cost executable value remains

model_ladder.role: allowed only if the logistic model demonstrably underfits development data
allowed only after simpler models pass data and execution sanity checks
never the base price forecaster; must add sealed after-cost uplift and may only abstain or reduce risk until independently promoted

predecessor.round26_role: development pilot and settlement-mechanism audit only

research_evidence.finding: A 727 million row synchronized Polymarket-Binance study found quote response after large Binance moves but no tradable out-of-sample edge after costs; incremental value must beat the book prior, not only predict direction.
Deep limit-order-book forecast accuracy does not necessarily imply actionable trading signals, motivating transaction-level economic evaluation.
Crypto price discovery is materially driven by limit submissions and cancellations, so trade returns alone are an incomplete signal family.
Polymarket crypto taker fees follow the exact symmetric probability curve used by this design.
The official market channel exposes L2 books, price changes and resolution events used as public evidence.
